en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Umar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Ghanam b. Hakim narrated to us. He said: Shurayh b. Maslama narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Yusuf narrated to us from `Abd al-Jabbar from al-A`mash al-Thaqafi from Abi’l Sadiq.
He said: `Ali (as) said to me: This verse is for us or about us,
“We wanted to confer favour upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them Imams and make them the inheritors.” [28:5]
